title: Hold an authority to possess explosives
what: Possess explosives only under an authority (licence) that covers them.

sources.title: Explosives Act 1999 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not possess an explosive unless the person holds an authority that authorises the person to possess the explosive

sources.title: Explosives Act 1999 (Qld)
sources.locator: sch 2, def chief inspector, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: chief inspector means the inspector designated by the CEO as the chief inspector for this Act.
